learnerTask: Connect a specific normal-versus-altered sequence to a candidate peptide while retaining separate presentation and recognition evidence.
gap: The evidence table distinguishes the gates well but does not show how an altered sequence changes a candidate fragment. A small normal/altered sequence inset can reuse the antigen-processing owner rather than duplicating its full pathway.
accuracyGuardrails: An alteration can yield several candidates or none useful.
An unusual transcript is not automatically tumor-exclusive.
Sequence-specific novelty does not establish recognition, safety or benefit.
